edits.old: 10. When a personal field is returned unmasked, `PiiAccessLogClient` writes the read through the rwb-access access log, each entry carrying user, role, case ID, data product, field ID and time and no value; when that write fails, the read is refused rather than returned unmasked (FSD P1 A2.15, BR-P1-015-4; its operation and retry rule are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0586; ASM-0828)).
edits.new: 10. When a personal field is returned unmasked, `PiiAccessLogClient` writes the read through the rwb-access access log, each entry carrying the user, the product, the case and the time of the read and never the value; when that write fails, the read is refused rather than returned unmasked (FSD P1 A2.15, BR-P1-015-4; its operation and retry rule are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0586; ASM-0828)).

edits.old: Screen Specifications v1 does not state the Empty, Error or No access state of SCR-03; those are Not specified in the source documents (CG-ALL-2329), and this story serves only the data behind them. This story serves the data behind those states and renders none of them.
edits.new: Screen Specifications v1 states no No access state for SCR-03; that state is the refusal of steps 5 and 7 in section 4, step 14, and any state beyond the Loading, Empty, Error and No access states of SCR-03 is Not specified in the source documents (CG-ALL-2329). This story serves the data behind those states and renders none of them.

findings.issue: The added section 3 line puts the date '26 November 2026' (a dated directive reference) into the story; dates are forbidden.
The four new scenario titles (AC9-AC12) carry the decision ID and change-log marker '(new, D-RCV-60)'.
Section 15 declares the SCR-03 Empty, Error and No access states Not specified, contradicting the same paragraph (Empty, Error) and section 4 step 14 (No access).
Step 10 adds 'role' and 'field ID' to the access-log entry; the item and the story (section 17) name only the user, product, case and time.
X2 now defines the out-of-scope mapping, contradicting section 3/4 ('status ... Not specified ... keeps the legacy 404; RWB-P3-E1018-CON fixes it') and editing the story for a cross-document item.
The note says section 16 has 13 rows; the story now carries 15 test rows (TC-E1-068-01 to -15).
